ideal: Every page draws only from the design tokens, reads clearly at every size, paints fast, holds still while loading and stays light to download.

parts.ideal: Every color in the code comes from the palette tokens; none is typed raw
parts.setup: Keep the palette in one token file; list each exempt file or line, with its reason, in the raw scan exemptions

parts.ideal: Spacing and sizes come from the token scale; a border or icon size may stay raw
parts.setup: Add a size scale to the token file and swap raw px in components for its steps

parts.ideal: Every visible text size is a step of the type scale
parts.setup: Name a JSON or YAML token file with type steps in params.tokens

parts.ideal: Every visible text color is a palette token
parts.setup: The same token file, with its color entries

parts.ideal: All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast at every width: 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text
parts.setup: Pair text and background tokens that pass; axe-core checks every key page at each width

parts.ideal: Largest Contentful Paint within 2.5 s and layout shift under 0.1 on a phone
parts.setup: Size and preload the main image, reserve space for media and fonts, ship less script

parts.ideal: Every key page under 1,600 KiB to load
parts.setup: Compress images, cut unused script and load below-the-fold media lazily

sources.title: Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10, Design Tokens Community Group
Alex Russell: The Performance Inequality Gap, 2026
Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, W3C Recommendation

quality: No raw color or size outside the tokens, all text on the type scale and palette, and contrast that meets WCAG 2.2 AA.
speed: Largest Contentful Paint within 2.5 s and layout shift under 0.1, on a phone.
consumption: Every key page under 1,600 KiB to load.
